logo.description: Rounded, upright numeral 8 in a blue-to-violet-to-pink gradient; two counters; no mouth, bite, document, face or letter A.

functional_promise: Drop your files. Tell atepdf what to do. Get the result.
privacy_explanation: Cloud AI interprets your instructions. PDF processing happens on your device.
ui_policy: Preserve the previously approved file-drop and instruction workspace. Replace only old brand name and logo; do not copy layouts from the brand board.
empty_state_mascot: Keep the approved paper illustration as secondary illustration, not the brand mark.
technical_identity_policy: Fresh independent atepdf development namespaces. Do not inherit or mutate legacy production bundle IDs, app groups, OAuth apps, storage, purchase SKUs or customer entitlements by default. Historical handoff/schema labels may remain. Any production reuse or migration needs explicit approval.
